scope: Read-only review of bounded PNG capture, guarded publication, queue ownership/restart, relevant regression cases, and qualification recorder. No PNG execution performed in this review.
review_conclusions: UI restricts admission to one native local regular file of at most 64 MiB. Host capture rechecks identity/stat, rejects oversized/short/invalid chunks, and keeps a private source snapshot.

Candidate/result lists are immutable; recovered bytes are exposed read-only, selections are frozen before asynchronous admission/execution, and ZIP members/digests are read back using a distinct reader.
Guarded publication is a distinct capability. Unsupported backends reject before consuming output; replace=true is rejected; native installation uses exclusive OS rename with no replacing fallback.
Committing journal callback completes before full source and stage proofs. A synchronous control-change listener increments pause epochs, so even transient pause/resume invalidates prior proofs.
Native writer performs its final asynchronous type probe, then synchronous authority/cancellation/epoch guard, then the FFI exclusive rename without another asynchronous boundary.
Observed install is authoritative: later Stop, backend revocation or completion observer errors cannot reclassify saved output as uninstalled; failures are retained as publication warnings.

Queue owns admitted handle/control after durable creation, including view disposal while admission is pending. Source review snapshot lives in the execution closure, while journal contains offsets/digests and receipts only.
PNG restart cannot enter ordinary copy recovery or create-archive recipe recovery. Its recovery view requires a new scan and review and retains saved paths/digests.
known_limits: Final rehash and path checks are not an atomic filesystem snapshot or compare-and-swap against arbitrary external writers. Concurrent destination collision is protected by exclusive rename.
Source and output are separately capped at 64 MiB; aggregate decoded scanlines, candidate/chunk/validation-work caps are also enforced. This is not a 64 MiB total-memory claim.

Host capture/proof streams use a 262144-chunk cap, a 30-second inactivity timeout and two-minute elapsed clock. The elapsed clock includes user pause time; a long pause can therefore produce a safe bounded-read failure after resume.
Native Linux regression coverage does not establish actual execution on Windows/macOS/mobile. Browser/cloud publication remains disabled.

Abrupt process loss after exclusive installation but before durable completion can leave an unfinished job receipt; retained output is not automatically overwritten and restart requires explicit new review.

initial_findings: Untracked non-evidence source/suites were neither rejected nor included in stability equality.
Observed suites with zero visible tests could satisfy qualification.
recorder_review.status: Root corrected both findings during review; focused synthetic controls validate the corrected recorder. No reviewer source edits.
recorder_review.remaining_scope: Before/after equality cannot prove absence of transient writes. External dependency payloads and executables are not a hermetic snapshot unless separately supplied as tool hashes. The recorder explicitly declares these limits; command exit zero alone only qualifies the recorded command scope.
